dedupe_keys.name: towards the development of an online platform for an industry metabolic pathway

description: The authors describe a developed web-based decision platform for exploring industrial-symbiosis configurations involving water treatment and resource recovery. It combines three cases concerning greenhouse water and nutrient recovery, olive-mill wastewater pretreatment before municipal treatment, and valuable-compound recovery at a juice factory. The platform presents an abstract composite configuration with interactive visualizations. This establishes implemented decision functions, but the composite example is not a physically deployed three-industry network. The article and related metal-concentration supplement are public descriptions; the inspected metadata do not identify a verified service endpoint, available source code, installation or software licence. The source documents a water quality treatment or recovery study. The source authors provide this description through Zenodo, whose deposit declares CC BY 4.0 and public document access. Geographic and temporal coverage remain limited to the cases or observations explicitly described. Only metadata and file descriptors were reviewed; no document, measurements, model archive or code was read. Related components retain their source identities and uncertain experimental overlap. Document access and licensing do not establish executable availability or software rights.
